title: International diabète Federation-diabète et Ramadan Alliance (IDF-DAR) Fasting risque évaluation
short_title: IDF-DAR — Évaluation du risque lié au jeûne
abbreviations: International Diabetes Federation - Diabetes and Ramadan Alliance fasting risk
formula:
The IDF-DAR Fasting Risk Score is calculated by the addition of the selected points:

| Variable | Points | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Diabetes type and duration | | |
| Diabetes type | Type 2 diabetes | 0 |
| Type 1 diabetes | 1 | |
| Years since diabetes diagnosis | <10 years | 0 |
| ≥10 years | 1 | |
| Presence of hypoglycemia | No hypoglycemia | 0 |
| Hypoglycemia <1 time per week | 1 | |
| Hypoglycemia multiple times per week | 3.5 | |
| Recent severe hypoglycemia | 5.5 | |
| Hypoglycemia unawareness | 6.5 | |
| Level of glycemic control | HbA1c levels <7.5% (58.5 mmol/mol) | 0 |
| HbA1c levels 7.5-9% (58.5-75 mmol/mol) | 1 | |
| HbA1c levels >9% (75 mmol/mol) | 2 | |
| Type of treatment | Other therapy not including SU or insulin | 0 |
| Gliclazide/MR or glimepiride or repaglinide | 0.5 | |
| Glibenclamide | 1 | |
| Basal insulin | 1.5 | |
| Once daily mixed insulin | 2 | |
| Basal bolus/insulin pump | 2.5 | |
| Multiple daily mixed insulin injections | 3 | |
| Self-monitoring of blood glucose (SMBG) | Conducted as indicated | 0 |
| Indicated but conducted suboptimally | 1 | |
| Indicated but not conducted | 2 | |
| Acute complications | No DKA or HHS | 0 |
| DKA/HHS in the last 12 months | 1 | |
| DKA/HHS in the last 6 months | 2 | |
| DKA/HHS in the last 3 months | 3 | |
| MVD complications/comorbidities | No MVD | 0 |
| Stable MVD | 2 | |
| Unstable MVD | 6.5 | |
| Renal complications/comorbidities | eGFR >60mL/min | 0 |
| eGFR 45-60mL/min | 2 | |
| eGFR 30-45mL/min | 4 | |
| eGFR <30mL/min | 6.5 | |
| Pregnancy | Not pregnant | 0 |
| Pregnant within targets | 3.5 | |
| Pregnant not within targets | 6.5 | |
| Frailty and cognitive function | No frailty or loss in cognitive function | 0 |
| >70 years old with no home support | 3.5 | |
| Impaired cognitive function or frail | 6.5 | |
| Physical labor | No physical labor | 0 |
| Moderately intense physical labor | 2 | |
| Highly intense physical labor | 4 | |
| Previous Ramadan experience | Positive experience | 0 |
| Negative experience | 1 | |
| Fasting hours | <16 h | 0 |
| ≥16 h | 1 | |

**Clarifications:**

- Definition of pregnant within targets:

 - HbA1c <7% (for pre-GDM)
 - Fasting glucose <95 mg/dL with either (for GDM or pre-GDM):

 - 1-hr postprandial glucose <140 mg/dL OR
 - 2-hr postprandial glucose <120 mg/dL
- Definition of overall negative experience: difficulty fasting during a previous Ramadan necessitating breaking the fast on ≥2 days due to diabetes-related issues (e.g., hypoglycemia, hyperglycemia, dehydration).

how_to_use.why: Peut être utilisé pour guider les conseils et les plans de prise en charge des patients diabétiques qui ont l’intention de jeûner pendant le Ramadan afin de minimiser le risque d’événements indésirables liés au diabète.
how_to_use.when:
- Idéalement utilisé lors de l'évaluation médicale des patients diabétiques avant le début du Ramadan.
- Évalue le risque d'événements indésirables chez un patient diabétique jeûnant pendant le Ramadan.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Some validation studies note that this tool may overestimate the risk of adverse events in some patients.
- Principal adverse outcomes of fasting assessed in validation studies included hypoglycemia, hyperglycemia, and hospitalization.

**Clarifications:**

- Definition of pregnant within targets:

 - HbA1c <7% (for pre-GDM)
 - Fasting glucose <95 mg/dL with either (for GDM or pre-GDM):

 - 1-hr postprandial glucose <140 mg/dL OR
 - 2-hr postprandial glucose <120 mg/dL
- Definition of overall negative experience: difficulty fasting during a previous Ramadan necessitating breaking the fast on ≥2 days due to diabetes-related issues (e.g., hypoglycemia, hyperglycemia, dehydration).

next_steps.advice:
| Risk Category | Medical Designation |
| --- | --- |
| Low risk | Fasting is probably safe. |
| Moderate risk | Fasting safety is uncertain. |
| High risk | Fasting is probably unsafe. |
next_steps.management:
- Le jeûne est une décision personnelle.
- Fournir une éducation sur la reconnaissance des symptômes d’hypoglycémie et d’hyperglycémie.
- Quel que soit le groupe de risque du patient, il convient de conseiller aux patients de rompre leur jeûne s’ils présentent des épisodes d’hypoglycémie.
- Encourager une surveillance étroite de la glycémie pendant les heures de jeûne. Souligner que la mesure de la glycémie pendant le Ramadan ne rompt pas le jeûne.
- Une adaptation du plan de traitement du diabète du patient peut être nécessaire pour éviter des événements indésirables pendant le jeûne.
- Faire preuve de flexibilité dans les objectifs glycémiques pendant le Ramadan.
- Envisager une consultation en nutrition médicale.
- Pour des conseils supplémentaires, voir les [recommandations consensuelles ADA/EASD pour la prise en charge du diabète pendant le Ramadan](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32366501/) ou les [lignes directrices pratiques Diabète et Ramadan](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35016991/).
